item.title: NOW YOU SEE ME: NOW YOU DON'T Filmmakers Talk Biggest Twists & Turns, The Next Sequel & More! (Exclusive)
item.description: With Now You See Me: Now You Don't now playing in theaters, we recently caught up with director Ruben Fleischer and producer Bobby Cohen to talk about the long-awaited threequel and what comes next!

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Rumors May Reveal Doctor Doom's REAL Plan And Some "Unannounced" Characters - SPOILERS
item.description: Some more Avengers: Doomsday rumors here, this time relating to Doctor Doom's plan to get Earth's Mightiest Heroes on his side. We also have some updates on some of the movie's unannounced characters...

item.title: MAN OF TOMORROW Director James Gunn Shares Wonder Twins Art; Responds To Pierce Brosnan's Dr. Fate Comments
item.description: James Gunn has responded to Black Adam star Pierce Brosnan's recent comments about Dr. Fate appearing in the next Superman movie, while also prompting speculation with a Wonder Twins image...

item.title: AVATAR: Varang Unleashes FIRE AND ASH In Action-Packed Final Trailer For James Cameron's Threequel
item.description: A little earlier than expected, Disney has debuted a final trailer for James Cameron's Avatar: Fire and Ash, and it finds the Sully family facing their most dangerous foe yet...

item.title: SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY Star Sadie Sink Officially Cast In AVENGERS: SECRET WARS
item.description: Stranger Things star Sadie Sink's MCU role just got even more intriguing, as it's been revealed today that the actress will reprise her role in Avengers: Secret Wars, or possibly Avengers: Doomsday...

item.title: AVENGERS: DOOMSDAY Star Simu Liu Mounts An Impassioned Defense Of The Superhero Movie Genre
item.description: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings star Simu Liu has spoken out in defence of the superhero movie genre while saying the time he spent on the Avengers: Doomsday set was his "dream come true."
